title: hooks / Existing Local hooks
content: ## Existing Local hooks Use this section only to identify an existing Local setup before [migrating it](/docs/agent-customization/migrate-customizations.md#migrate-hooks). * Local discovers repository and user hook files, configured `chat.hookFilesLocations`, and agent or plugin hooks. Claude settings files require `chat.useClaudeHooks`. * `chat.useHooks` controls Local execution. These settings do not configure the shared Copilot runtime. * The Local parser accepts PascalCase and Copilot event aliases, command aliases, and nested Claude command groups. It ignores matcher values and still sends Local payloads. * Local agent-scoped hooks require a trusted workspace and `chat.useHooks`. A scoped `Stop` hook is treated as `SubagentStop` when the agent runs as a subagent. The [Local reference](/docs/agents/reference/hooks-reference.md) retains the configuration, input, and output details needed to convert those scripts. For new hooks, use the Copilot examples above.
